title: Garden and Letters
author: Bram Ashgrove
blurb: Rafael Eastwick, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
